description: Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto signs in both the Western tropical zodiac and the Vedic sidereal zodiac (Lahiri), Moon nakshatra, retrograde flags, and optional Ascendant/MC/Lagna when latitude and longitude are given. Use for questions like 'what is my moon sign', 'my Vedic rashi', 'my Venus sign'. Returns explanation page links and a link to a full free reading.

time.description: Local birth time HH:MM 24h. Defaults to 12:00; the Moon can change sign within a day, so ask for the time.

utc_offset.description: Hours from UTC at the birthplace on that date, e.g. 9 Tokyo, 5.5 India, -3 São Paulo, -5 New York winter / -4 summer, 1 Madrid winter / 2 summer

name: calculate_birth_chart_signs
title: Western + Vedic signs for a birth moment
